update.title: Major Release: Full Cockpit Integration
features: Interactive Overhead Panel: Full zero-latency overhead control for ToLiss (A319-A340), Fenix A320 v3, FlyByWire A32NX, and iniBuilds (MSFS 2024).
Fenix MCDU & EFB Integration: Access and interact with your Fenix MCDU and Electronic Flight Bag directly inside Simulator Station.
Virtual Flight Control: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a zero-latency gyroscope flight controller with integrated throttle, flaps, spoilers, and brakes.
Upgraded Head Tracking: Re-engineered for fluid, jitter-free precision that rivals dedicated standalone head-tracking hardware.
Completely Ad-Free Experience: Permanently removed all banner ads for a clean, focused, distraction-free flight deck.
Refined UI & Core Fixes: Polished layouts, boosted performance, and resolved altitude discrepancies when repositioning your aircraft.

announcement.title: Major Release: A New Level of Control
announcement.body:
Welcome to our biggest leap in cockpit integration yet! Take direct command with our brand-new zero-latency Interactive Overhead Panel (supporting ToLiss, Fenix, FlyByWire, and iniBuilds), native Fenix MCDU & EFB integration, and hardware-free Virtual Flight Control powered by your device's gyroscope.

We have also permanently removed all ads across the app, significantly upgraded Head Tracking accuracy, and fixed aircraft repositioning altitude bugs. Enjoy a cleaner, faster, and truly connected flight deck.

promo_banner.title: Interactive Overhead Panel
promo_banner.body: Manage every overhead switch and annunciator with zero latency directly from your screen. Full support for ToLiss, Fenix A320 v3, FlyByWire A32NX, and iniBuilds.
